WITH race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.date > '1978-03-04' AND r.date < '2003-03-09'
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_count) as avg_count
  FROM race_counts
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  rc.circuitId,
  rc.country,
  rc.race_count,
  rc.race_count / ca.avg_count as ratio
FROM race_counts rc
LEFT JOIN country_averages ca ON rc.country = ca.country
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
